milanese.name: Milanese Mesh Watch Strap
milanese.short: Woven stainless steel mesh with a magnetic clasp that slides to any length. Widths 15mm to 22mm.
milanese.etsy_title: Milanese Mesh Watch Strap, Magnetic Stainless Steel Band 15mm 16mm 17mm 18mm 19mm 20mm 21mm 22mm, Adjustable Replacement Bracelet
milanese.description:
Milanese mesh watch strap in woven stainless steel with a magnetic clasp - slides to any length for an exact fit, in widths from 15mm to 22mm.

No holes to line up and no spare links to remove. Slide the clasp to the point that fits your wrist and the magnet holds it there. The flat weave sits close to the skin without pulling hair, and the low-profile closure slips easily under a shirt cuff.

WHY BUYERS CHOOSE THIS STRAP
- Magnetic clasp gives a stepless fit anywhere along the band
- Woven stainless steel mesh: smooth, flexible and breathable
- Slim profile suits dress watches and everyday watches alike
- Tarnish-resistant finish, wipes clean in seconds
- Unisex - works on both men and women watches

WIDTHS AVAILABLE
15mm, 16mm, 17mm, 18mm, 19mm, 20mm, 21mm and 22mm.

Odd sizes such as 17mm, 19mm and 21mm are often hard to find - all of them are stocked here.

HOW TO FIND YOUR SIZE
Measure the gap between the lugs, the two horns where the old strap meets the watch case, in millimetres. That measurement is your strap width. If your old strap is still fitted, measure its width at the case end.

WHAT IT FITS
A universal replacement band for any watch using standard spring bars in the widths above. Buyers commonly fit these to classic and dress watches, field watches and fashion watches - including Tissot, Seiko, Casio, Daniel Wellington, Longines, Hamilton, Omega, Cartier and Mido models in matching lug widths.

This is an aftermarket replacement strap. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by any watch brand, and no watch is included. Please check your lug width before ordering.

SPECIFICATIONS
- Material: stainless steel, Milanese mesh weave
- Clasp: magnetic slide clasp
- Lug widths: 15 / 16 / 17 / 18 / 19 / 20 / 21 / 22 mm
- Adjustment: stepless, no tools and no link removal
- Style: unisex
- In the box: 1 watch strap with spring bars

FITTING
The strap attaches with standard spring bars and most watches take under a minute with a spring bar tool. Any watch shop or jeweller can also fit it in moments.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Avoid prolonged submersion, perfume and harsh chemicals. Dry fully after contact with water or sweat.

PLEASE NOTE
The clasp contains a small magnet. If you wear a pacemaker or another implanted medical device, check with your doctor before use, and keep the strap away from bank cards and direct contact with mechanical watch movements.

nylon.name: Woven Nylon Watch Strap with Magnetic Clasp
nylon.short: Breathable woven nylon with a magnetic clasp and quick-release spring bars. Widths 16mm to 24mm.
nylon.etsy_title: Nylon Watch Strap, Magnetic Clasp Quick Release Band 16mm 17mm 18mm 19mm 20mm 21mm 22mm 23mm 24mm, Breathable Woven Replacement Bracelet
nylon.description:
Woven nylon watch strap with a magnetic clasp and quick-release spring bars - swap it onto your watch in seconds, in widths from 16mm to 24mm.

The magnetic clasp closes anywhere along the band, so there are no holes to line up and no fixed notches to settle for. Built-in quick-release spring bars mean no tools and no scratched lugs: press the lever, lift the strap off, drop the new one on.

WHY BUYERS CHOOSE THIS STRAP
- Magnetic clasp gives a stepless fit at any point on the band
- Quick-release pins fit and remove in seconds with no tools
- Woven nylon is light, breathable and comfortable in heat
- Soft weave with no hard edges against the wrist
- Unisex design suited to sport, casual and everyday watches

WIDTHS AVAILABLE
16mm, 17mm, 18mm, 19mm, 20mm, 21mm, 22mm, 23mm and 24mm.

Odd sizes such as 17mm, 19mm, 21mm and 23mm are difficult to find elsewhere - every size above is stocked.

HOW TO FIND YOUR SIZE
Measure the gap between the lugs, the two horns where the strap meets the watch case, in millimetres. That figure is your strap width. If the old strap is still fitted, measure its width at the case end.

WHAT IT FITS
A universal replacement band for any watch with standard spring bars in the widths above. Buyers commonly fit these to sport, field, dive and everyday watches - including Garmin, Tissot, Longines, Citizen, Casio and Daniel Wellington models in matching lug widths.

This is an aftermarket replacement strap. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by any watch brand, and no watch is included. Please check your lug width before ordering.

SPECIFICATIONS
- Material: woven nylon with metal clasp
- Clasp: magnetic slide clasp
- Attachment: quick-release spring bars included
- Lug widths: 16 / 17 / 18 / 19 / 20 / 21 / 22 / 23 / 24 mm
- Adjustment: stepless, no tools required
- Style: unisex
- In the box: 1 watch strap with quick-release spring bars

FITTING
The quick-release bars have a small lever on the underside. Retract it, seat one side in the lug, then release. Most watches take well under a minute and no tools are needed.

CARE
Hand wash in cool water with mild soap and air dry fully. Avoid bleach, solvents and tumble drying. Let the strap dry completely before wearing it again.

PLEASE NOTE
The clasp contains a small magnet. If you wear a pacemaker or another implanted medical device, check with your doctor before use, and keep the strap away from bank cards and direct contact with mechanical watch movements.

parachute.name: Parachute Nylon Watch Strap
parachute.short: Light parachute-style nylon webbing with quick-release spring bars. Widths 20mm and 22mm.
parachute.etsy_title: Parachute Nylon Watch Strap 20mm 22mm, Quick Release Woven Sport Band, Breathable Replacement Bracelet Unisex
parachute.description:
Parachute-style nylon watch strap with quick-release spring bars, available in 20mm and 22mm - a light, breathable band that fits both smartwatches and traditional watches.

Parachute webbing is built to be strong and light. The weave is soft against the wrist straight away with no break-in period, and it dries quickly after sport or a warm day.

WHY BUYERS CHOOSE THIS STRAP
- Quick-release spring bars fit and remove in seconds with no tools
- Light, breathable woven nylon, comfortable in heat
- Soft weave with no hard edges or pressure points
- Traditional buckle closure for a secure, familiar fit
- Unisex design suited to sport, outdoor and everyday wear

WIDTHS AVAILABLE
20mm and 22mm.

WHAT IT FITS
This is a universal strap. It fits any watch with standard spring bars and a matching lug width - not one model or one make. That includes most smartwatches as well as conventional analogue watches.

Buy by lug width, not by model name. If the gap between your watch lugs measures 20mm, choose 20mm; if it measures 22mm, choose 22mm.

HOW TO FIND YOUR SIZE
Measure the gap between the lugs, the two horns where the strap meets the watch case, in millimetres. That figure is your strap width. If your current strap is still fitted, measure it at the case end, not in the middle, where it may taper.

Please check that your watch uses standard spring bars. A few smartwatches use a proprietary connector instead of a spring bar and will need an adapter - if there is no spring bar between the lugs, this strap will not attach directly.

This is an aftermarket replacement strap. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by any watch manufacturer, and no watch is included.

SPECIFICATIONS
- Material: woven nylon parachute-style webbing
- Closure: buckle
- Attachment: quick-release spring bars included
- Lug widths: 20mm and 22mm
- Style: unisex
- In the box: 1 watch strap with quick-release spring bars

FITTING
The quick-release bars have a small lever on the underside. Retract the lever, seat one end in the lug, then release so the bar springs into place. Check the strap is held firmly before wearing. Most watches take under a minute and no tools are needed.

CARE
Hand wash in cool water with mild soap and air dry fully. Avoid bleach, solvents and tumble drying. Let the strap dry completely before wearing it again.
